_comment: Shared by tests/js/rule-engine.test.mjs and tests/Unit/PostureRuleValidatorTest.php so the JS engine and the PHP validator reject the same mistakes with the same messages. `set` and `unset` take dot paths into the base rule's config (numbers index arrays).

cases.name: wrong schema version
cases.expect: schema must be 1

cases.name: unknown side
cases.expect: side must be one of auto, left, right, both

cases.name: min visibility out of range
cases.expect: min_visibility must be a number between 0.1 and 0.95

cases.name: good score out of range
cases.expect: good_score must be a number between 0 and 100

cases.name: unknown required point
cases.expect: unknown point "banana" in required

cases.name: angle needs three points
cases.expect: measure "elbow": points must list exactly 3 points

cases.name: unknown point inside a measure
cases.expect: unknown point "pinky_toe" in measure "elbow"

cases.name: unknown measure type
cases.expect: measure "elbow" has unknown type "spin"

cases.name: inclination reference
cases.expect: measure "torso_sway": ref must be vertical or horizontal

cases.name: bad relative mode
cases.expect: measure "torso_sway": relative must be one of delta, ratio

cases.name: rep signal must be a measure
cases.expect: rep.signal "nope" is not a measure

cases.name: start equals peak
cases.expect: rep.start and rep.peak must differ

cases.name: tolerance too large
cases.expect: rep.tolerance must be smaller than half the range between start and peak

cases.name: max below min
cases.expect: rep.max_ms must be greater than rep.min_ms

cases.name: partial message must be short text
cases.expect: rep.partial_message must be a short text (110 characters at most)

cases.name: duplicate check id
cases.expect: duplicate check id "body_swing"

cases.name: check measure must exist
cases.expect: check "body_swing": measure "ghost" does not exist

cases.name: bad operator
cases.expect: check "body_swing": op must be one of <, >, outside, inside

cases.name: outside needs a range
cases.expect: check "body_swing": value must be [low, high] for outside

cases.name: rep check needs a stat
cases.expect: check "lockout": stat must be one of min, max, peak, range

cases.name: unknown segment
cases.expect: check "body_swing": unknown segment "tail"

cases.name: frames out of range
cases.expect: check "body_swing": frames must be a whole number between 1 and 30

cases.name: unknown phase
cases.expect: check "body_swing": phases must be a list of rest, out, peak, back, hold

cases.name: message is required
cases.expect: check "body_swing": message is required

cases.name: hold needs conditions
cases.expect: rep.in_position must list at least one condition for a hold

cases.name: hold conditions reference measures
cases.expect: rep.in_position[0] must reference a measure

cases.name: rep checks are not allowed in a hold
cases.expect: check "hips_sagging": rep-scope checks need a movement rep, not a hold

cases.name: diff must reference measures
cases.expect: measure "arm_unevenness": a must reference another measure
